subject: Can Ms. Smith afford to wait?
preheader: Some equipment may still arrive before Christmas. It is worth checking what's possible now.
intro: Christmas deadlines have a way of turning an equipment request into a January problem.
That might look like a few weeks on a calendar. It can feel very different for the person waiting at home.
sectionTitle: Can Ms. Smith afford to wait?
body: This week, a supplier told us an order for a chair needs to be placed by the end of November to meet its planned pre-Christmas delivery window.
Not every piece of equipment will make it. But before we write off December, it's worth finding out what can still be sourced and delivered.
secondTitle: The product is only part of the timing
secondBody: Stock, size, configuration, accessories and delivery access can each change the answer. We can check availability, look at viable alternatives and coordinate the practical details.
actionBody: Send us the equipment request, the suburb and the date it's needed. A de-identified brief is enough to start.
We'll check the options and tell you what can realistically be arranged before Christmas.
